mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_participant(meeting_id, user_id, email_notification, role, permission, timetable_case, vote_case) VALUES (#{meetingId}, #{userId}, #{emailNotification}, #{role}, #{permission}, #{timetableCase}, #{voteCase})
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.nickname, mp.role, mp.timetable_case, ma.start_time, ma.end_time FROM meeting_participant mp JOIN users u ON mp.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN meeting_availability ma ON mp.meeting_participant_id = ma.meeting_participant_id WHERE mp.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY mp.role ASC
SELECT meeting_participant_id FROM meeting_participant WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE meeting_participant SET timetable_case = true WHERE meeting_participant_id = #{participantId} AND timetable_case = false
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meeting_participant WHERE meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND timetable_case = false

SELECT mvc.meeting_candidate_id, mvc.start_time, mvc.end_time, CASE WHEN mvr.meeting_participant_id IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS isVoted FROM meeting_vote_candidate mvc LEFT JOIN meeting_vote_record mvr ON mvc.meeting_candidate_id = mvr.meeting_candidate_id LEFT JOIN meeting_participant mp ON mvr.meeting_participant_id = mp.meeting_participant_id AND mp.user_id = #{userId} WHERE mvc.meeting_id = #{meetingId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meeting_participant mp LEFT JOIN meeting_vote_record mvr ON mp.meeting_participant_id = mvr.meeting_participant_id WHERE mp.meeting_id = #{meetingId} AND mvr.meeting_participant_id IS NULL

SELECT mp.meeting_participant_id, CASE WHEN mp.user_id = #{userId} THEN true ELSE false END AS isMe, u.nickname, mp.permission, mp.role FROM meeting_participant mp JOIN users u ON mp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE mp.meeting_id = #{meetingId} ORDER BY mp.role ASC
